notes.title: 香港玩家们，大家好！
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540363/c274a7c17ae9d950348d1848fe8bac58a0cc8255.png"][/img]
[b]香港玩家们，大家好！[/b][/p][p] 我是 \[Reokie]，《YellowDemon》的开发者。[/p][p] 我很高兴地宣布，《YellowDemon》试玩版将在七月底前本地化为简体中文。[/p][p] 本次本地化将涵盖大部分界面和游戏玩法要素。[/p][p] 敬请期待后续更新！[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540363/9dad7718060c27ee39f7610f2b2c185e8c322110.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Experience the Yellow*Demon demo July 15th!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540363/c274a7c17ae9d950348d1848fe8bac58a0cc8255.png"][/img]

The demo for Yellow*Demon is almost complete! Prepare for arcade survival action on 
July 15th, when the DEMO version arrives on Steam! Expect the trailer any time before[/p][p]then. Again thank you in your interest in  Yellow*Demon. [/p][p][/p][p]- Reokie [/p]
